messages.text: I ordered the wrong product I just ordered just now and I was supposed to be getting the magicmirer 40th for 799. Instead I got the other one and that's not what I wanted I hope you can help
I'll pull your order up now.
Used the store-orders skill

Good news, Rob, you did get the right one. Order Shop···· has the Magic Miner 40T at $799, ships December 7, 2026.

The only other thing on it is a $40 add-on, Harlo OS Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA, which brings the total to $839. Nothing else was ordered.

Is that add-on the one you didn't want? Say the word and I'll take it off.
Yes, I don't need the addon's. Your customer service is excellent
Used the store-orders skill
Handed to the team · Line removal with $40 owed back to the customer; not something I can settle myse

Thanks, Rob, that's good to hear.

The add-on is $40 and taking it off means that $40 goes back to you, so one of the team handles that part. They've been pinged and will pick it up in this chat, so stay with us if you can. If you step away, you'll get the confirmation by email.

Your Magic Miner 40T stays as it is, $799, shipping December 7, 2026.
You rock. I still have a little tiny gold miner from you.
Used the store-orders skill
Handed to the team · KBOX order placed Sep 10, still unfulfilled, no ship date on the order and the m

The little gold one is the Bitaxe Gamma, you've got three of those with us, plus the two Nexus S1s. Nice setup.

While I have you: your KBOX from September hasn't gone out yet. The manufacturer is behind on units he owes us, and I don't have a firm date to give you. The team is already coming into this chat, so I've asked them to bring you the latest on it at the same time.
Love those Nexus

They're solid little units, quiet and they just keep running.

The 40T will feel like a different animal next to them, 40 TH/s from one box at 650 W. Good pairing.

Anything else you want me to check while the team picks up the add-on and the KBOX?
Not right now. Thank you. Incredible service!
Used the chat-interview skill
Before you go, one thing: you ordered the 40T with the diagnostics add-on attached, then wanted it off. What made you notice it only after checkout?
I didn't see it before
Useful to know, thanks. Was it on the product page or at checkout that it got added, as far as you remember?
Do you think it's something worth having or not so much.
Searched the catalog · Harlo OS Diagnostics 3-Month RMA add-on

Honestly, for you, not really. You've already run three Bitaxes and two Nexus units, so you're not the person who needs guided diagnostics. Faulty hardware goes through our normal RMA process either way, and tech help is free: JD and the community are in our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, and he's quick there.

If you were brand new to mining, I'd say it has value. In your case I'd keep the $40.
I have 22 minors being hosted and 15 in my basement. Still not making any money!!!! 💰
Ran the power-cost calculator

Ha, that's the honest truth of home mining right now. At retail power you're stacking sats and buying lottery tickets on a block, not printing cash. The margin lives in cheap power and in the coin price later.

The 40T helps there: 40 TH/s for $799 is the cheapest hashrate per dollar we sell, better than anything in the basement fleet. If you tell me what you pay per kWh in (address hidden), I'll run your real numbers.
I agree let's move forward with just the 40 th

Perfect, that's exactly what's flagged: the 40T stays, $799, shipping December 7, 2026, and the $40 add-on comes off with that $40 going back to you. The team is picking that part up and will confirm it with you here or by email.

Nothing else for you to do. Stay in the chat if you can.
Thank you

Anytime, Rob. Glad we caught it early.

You'll get a copy of this whole conversation by email once we're done here, so you'll have the 40T details and the add-on in writing.
Rock stars 🌟🌟

Appreciate that. Enjoy the 40T when it lands, it'll be the strongest unit in the basement.

If you're not already in there, our Discord is worth joining for new drops and help with the fleet: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Take care, Rob.
Joining your discord. I need to know about new drops thank you.

Good call, that's where drops get announced first and they move fast. JD is in there too, @nullhashrate, if you ever want hands-on help with the fleet.

Say hi when you're in. I'll leave this chat open for the team on your add-on.
